cards.title: Find your best days in **5 steps**

steps.title: Check analytics
steps.text: Look for audience activity by day.

steps.title: Hypothesis
steps.text: Write down which days should win.

steps.title: Fair test
steps.text: Change only the day, for 4 weeks.

cards.name: mistakes
cards.title: What makes the test reliable, and **what ruins it**

good.label: Reliable
items: Same time of day for every post
At least four weeks of posts

bad.label: Useless
items: Best video on one day only
Judging a day on one viral post

steps.title: Biggest segment
steps.text: Plan main posts for your top country.

steps.title: Rotate
steps.text: Alternate times so each region gets some.

steps.title: Long-life formats
steps.text: Pins and videos keep finding viewers.

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: The best day to post is the one **your own audience proves.**
cards.by: Test for four weeks, change only the day, then schedule around the winners.
